snippet.title: DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY coming to iOS/Android 2026
The latest entry in the DISSIDIA series

A new DISSIDIA story unfolds in modern Tokyo, where legendary FINAL FANTASY warriors assemble to save the world from destruction.
Defeat the boss faster than the enemy team in exhilarating, action-packed battles in this 3v3 Team Boss Battle Arena.

Sign Up for the Closed Beta Test (link)
Eligible Regions: United States and Canada
Recruitment available until October 28, 2025

Official Website: https://www.square-enix.com/ddff/en/
Official X: https://x.com/DDFF_EN

© SQUARE ENIX/NHN PlayArt
CHARACTER DESIGN: MIKI YAMASHITA / TETSUYA NOMURA

#DDFF #DISSIDIA
